data.text:
January has been a busy and sadly tragic start to the year. For those of us in Geneva, loss came close to home with the Crans-Montana fire, which claimed more than 40 young lives and injured over 100 people. A similar number died in train crashes in Spain. I know the  @CruzRojaEsp supported those affected, as did the @PRC_official after a devastating shopping centre fire earlier this month.

Colleagues have also been deeply engaged on global affairs, from developments in Venezuela to events in Iran. Many crises persist and worsen: in Gaza and Ukraine, harsh winter conditions are pushing communities further to the edge, while in the Philippines, Jamaica and Sri Lanka our support continues long after headlines fade.

Staying present after disaster is our strength. Our network continues to make a profound difference.
